    Description
    *New tapered leg
    Introducing our Mirage 5" Swim Shorts, featuring a two tone red giraffe pattern. These mens swim shorts are not only stylish but also highly functional. Crafted with a quick-drying fabric, they effortlessly transition from poolside relaxation to a dinner outing in dry comfort. Experience unparalleled comfort with the four-way stretch material and inner compression liner that ensures a snug fit while keeping everything comfortably in place. The elastic back waistband, coupled with a convenient drawstring closure, guarantees a personalised and secure fit. Equipped with zip pockets, these men’s red shorts provide a secure spot for your essentials. The vibrant red hue is not only eye-catching but also fade-proof, ensuring your Mirage Swim Shorts retain their bold color over time. Pair with our women’s Mirage Bikini for a cute couple look!

    Material:

    • Polyester and spandex.

    Features:

    • 4 way stretch material allows full range of motion & minimal restriction so you can swim, stroll & boogie comfortably.
    • Quick drying capabilities, so you can go from pool to party with no worries.
    • Smart-fit waistband featuring a drawstring closure at the front and elastic waistband at the back. This allows for the perfect adjustment/fit without compromising style.
    • Aqua Compression Liner that provides a safe and secure place to put the goods and eliminates discomfort and chaffing. 
    • Sand proof deep zipper pockets that keeps that sand out of your pockets and at the beach, where it belongs.
    • Durable fade proof color printing that will withstand salt water and chlorine. 
    Sizing:
    Model is 6ft, 83kg and wears a size Medium.

    Materials

    All Tucann Swimwear is made with a Nylon Spandex Blend that enables us to offer quick dry, 4 way stretch and sublimate high quality italian inks.

    Care

    To keep your swim trunks in top shape for years, follow these simple care tips:

    • Rinse After Use: After the beach or pool, rinse off excess sand and saltwater.

    • Hand Wash Only: Wash gently with soap and warm water.

    • Avoid machine washing to protect the zippers, logo, and hardware.

    • Air Dry: Lay flat in the shade, avoiding direct sunlight and tumble drying, which can damage the fabric.

    By caring for them properly, your swim trunks will last through countless vacations and beach days!

    Why you'll love them

    These aren't your standard swim trunks. Designed for the modern man who demands versatility, confidence, and all-day comfort.

    • Aqua Liner
      An innovative compression liner that completely eliminates chafing
    • Tailored Athletic Fit
      A clean length and flattering cut that compliments your physique
    • 4-Way Stretch Performance Fabric
      Moves with you whether you're swimming, surfing, or lounging
    • Quick-Dry Technology
      Dry in minutes—pool to dinner without changing
    • Secure Zip Pocket
      Keep your essentials safe while you're in the water and your phone free of cracks on land
    • Built to Endure
      High-quality construction and breathable lightweight fabric designed to retain fit, colour and structure season after season

    All swim trunks are printed using premium Italian inks for rich, lasting colour that won't fade over time.

    Tucanns Aqua Liner

    Compression lined swim trunks, crafted for comfort

    The Tucann Aqua Liner redefines men’s lined swim trunks with exceptional support, all-day comfort, and a secure fit—no underwear needed. The inner liner eliminates chafing whilst maintaining full mobility, making them the ultimate choice for style and performance in and out of the water.

    Industry pioneers

    In 2017 Tucann pioneered a compression liner made from swim short material in an industry first innovation.
